meta.description: Umbral threshold-PRE coalition exposure and per-scope bounding (diagnostic)

results.establishes: all 10 of C(5,3) subsets recover scope A's delegating secret
results.not_established: nothing about scopes not sampled; not a statement about other delegatees

results.establishes: recovered scope-A key decrypts a fresh same-scope ciphertext with no proxy step
results.not_established: says nothing about any other scope's ciphertexts

results.establishes: recovered scope-A key does NOT open an independently keyed scope-B ciphertext
results.not_established: FUNCTIONAL check on independent keys only; NOT a cross-scope confidentiality proof (a proof must bound the adversary's whole view; see LIM-1 and the doc)

results.establishes: share index x_i depends on dh_point = precursor*receiving_sk; a proxy lacks receiving_sk
results.not_established: the hardness itself: reconstruction-without-delegatee reduces to CDH and is ASSUMED, not shown

results.establishes: a key-inequality check (A != B) can hold while B is derivable from A (sk_B=2*sk_A)
results.not_established: NOT an attack on independent sampling; it shows inequality != independence/security
